## 9. Covid confounder

**Idea.** Covid affects wages and migration at the same time as Brexit. We build a
time-varying Covid measure for each residence area and add it as a control, so the
immigration coefficient is estimated *holding Covid conditions constant*. We use two measures:
(i) the OxCGRT **stringency index** (policy), (ii) **new Covid cases per 100,000** (the professor's suggestion).

Caveats to state in the write-up:
- OxCGRT UK data are by **nation** (England, Scotland, Wales, N. Ireland). All 16 English areas share England's value, so there are only 4 distinct Covid series.
- Quarter fixed effects already absorb anything common to all areas, so only the *differences across nations* identify the Covid coefficient.
- Case counts are not comparable after spring 2022 (testing changed). Pre-2020 = 0; after 2022 cases = 0 and the indices are held at the 2022Q4 value (the four nations are identical from 2022Q2).

```{r covid-build}
# Put OxCGRT_compact_subnational_v1.csv in project_dir.
oxcgrt_file <- file.path(project_dir, "OxCGRT_compact_subnational_v1.csv")
if (!file.exists(oxcgrt_file)) stop("Cannot find: ", oxcgrt_file)

# 20 residence areas -> UK nation
crosswalk <- tibble::tribble(
  ~residence, ~nation,
  "Tyne & Wear", "England", "Rest of Northern region", "England",
  "South Yorkshire", "England", "West Yorkshire", "England",
  "Rest of Yorks & Humberside", "England", "East Midlands", "England",
  "East Anglia", "England", "Inner London", "England", "Outer London", "England",
  "Rest of South East", "England", "South West", "England",
  "West Midlands (met county)", "England", "Rest of West Midlands", "England",
  "Greater Manchester", "England", "Merseyside", "England",
  "Rest of North West", "England", "Wales", "Wales",
  "Strathclyde", "Scotland", "Rest of Scotland", "Scotland",
  "Northern Ireland", "Northern Ireland"
)
# Check every area in the panel is mapped (names must match exactly)
unmapped <- setdiff(unique(panel$residence), crosswalk$residence)
if (length(unmapped)) stop("Residence names not in crosswalk: ", paste(unmapped, collapse = "; "))

ox <- readr::read_csv(oxcgrt_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(CountryCode == "GBR", !is.na(RegionName)) %>%       # nations only, drop UK total
  mutate(date = as.Date(as.character(Date), format = "%Y%m%d"),
         year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y")),
         quarter = (as.integer(format(date, "%m")) - 1L) %/% 3L + 1L) %>%
  arrange(RegionName, date) %>%
  group_by(RegionName) %>%
  mutate(new_cases = pmax(ConfirmedCases - lag(ConfirmedCases), 0)) %>%  # cumulative -> daily
  ungroup()

nation_q <- ox %>%
  group_by(nation = RegionName, year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(stringency = mean(StringencyIndex_Average, na.rm = TRUE),
            new_cases = sum(new_cases, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

last_q <- nation_q %>% filter(year == 2022, quarter == 4) %>%
  select(nation, stringency_last = stringency)

# Per-100k scaling uses the panel's population (16-64) summed within each nation
nation_pop <- panel %>% left_join(crosswalk, by = "residence") %>%
  group_by(nation, year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(nation_pop = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

covid_panel <- panel %>%
  select(residence, year, quarter) %>%
  left_join(crosswalk, by = "residence") %>%
  left_join(nation_q, by = c("nation", "year", "quarter")) %>%
  left_join(nation_pop, by = c("nation", "year", "quarter")) %>%
  left_join(last_q, by = "nation") %>%
  mutate(
    covid_stringency = case_when(year < 2020 ~ 0, year > 2022 ~ stringency_last, TRUE ~ stringency),
    covid_cases_p100k = case_when(year < 2020 | year > 2022 ~ 0,
                                  TRUE ~ 1e5 * new_cases / nation_pop)
  ) %>%
  select(residence, year, quarter, covid_stringency, covid_cases_p100k)

stopifnot(!anyNA(covid_panel$covid_stringency), !anyNA(covid_panel$covid_cases_p100k))
print(covid_panel %>% filter(residence %in% c("Inner London", "Wales"), year %in% 2020:2021) %>%
        arrange(residence, year, quarter))

quarterly_iv_covid <- quarterly_iv_panel %>%
  left_join(covid_panel, by = c("residence", "year", "quarter"))
post_c <- quarterly_iv_covid %>% filter(time > 2020 + 3 / 4)
```

## 10. Section A with Covid controls (baseline vs +stringency vs +cases)

```{r covid-section-a}
fs0 <- feols(d_ratio ~ shift_share + shift_share_lag | residence + period, data = post_c, vcov = ~ residence)
fs1 <- feols(d_ratio ~ shift_share + shift_share_lag + covid_stringency | residence + period, data = post_c, vcov = ~ residence)
fs2 <- feols(d_ratio ~ shift_share + shift_share_lag + covid_cases_p100k | residence + period, data = post_c, vcov = ~ residence)
etable(fs0, fs1, fs2, headers = c("Baseline", "+ Stringency", "+ Cases p100k"))

wp <- post_c %>% filter(is.finite(mean_log_hourpay), is.finite(d_ratio),
                        is.finite(shift_share), is.finite(shift_share_lag))
iv0 <- feols(mean_log_hourpay ~ shift_share_lag | residence + period | d_ratio ~ shift_share, data = wp, vcov = ~ residence)
iv1 <- feols(mean_log_hourpay ~ shift_share_lag + covid_stringency | residence + period | d_ratio ~ shift_share, data = wp, vcov = ~ residence)
iv2 <- feols(mean_log_hourpay ~ shift_share_lag + covid_cases_p100k | residence + period | d_ratio ~ shift_share, data = wp, vcov = ~ residence)
etable(iv0, iv1, iv2, headers = c("Baseline", "+ Stringency", "+ Cases p100k"))
```

Note: Section A already starts in 2021Q1, so 2020 is excluded by construction.

## 11. Section B with Covid controls, and dropping 2020 (professor's suggestion)

```{r covid-section-b}
ib <- quarterly_iv_covid %>%
  filter(year >= 2017) %>%
  mutate(post2021 = as.integer(year >= 2021),
         d_ratio_post = d_ratio * post2021,
         shift_share_post = shift_share * post2021) %>%
  filter(is.finite(mean_log_hourpay), is.finite(d_ratio), is.finite(d_ratio_post),
         is.finite(shift_share), is.finite(shift_share_post), is.finite(shift_share_lag))

run_b <- function(data, controls) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("mean_log_hourpay ~ shift_share_lag", controls,
                        "| residence + period | d_ratio + d_ratio_post ~ shift_share + shift_share_post"))
  m <- feols(f, data = data, vcov = ~ residence)
  b <- coef(m); V <- vcov(m)
  n1 <- "fit_d_ratio"; n2 <- "fit_d_ratio_post"
  post <- unname(b[n1] + b[n2])
  se <- sqrt(V[n1, n1] + V[n2, n2] + 2 * V[n1, n2])
  data.frame(pre = unname(b[n1]), diff = unname(b[n2]), post = post, post_se = se,
             post_p = 2 * pt(-abs(post / se), df = n_distinct(data$residence) - 1), n = nobs(m))
}

res <- bind_rows(
  cbind(spec = "Baseline (incl. 2020)",            run_b(ib, "")),
  cbind(spec = "+ Stringency (incl. 2020)",        run_b(ib, "+ covid_stringency")),
  cbind(spec = "+ Cases p100k (incl. 2020)",       run_b(ib, "+ covid_cases_p100k")),
  cbind(spec = "Baseline, drop 2020",              run_b(filter(ib, year != 2020), "")),
  cbind(spec = "+ Stringency, drop 2020",          run_b(filter(ib, year != 2020), "+ covid_stringency")),
  cbind(spec = "+ Cases p100k, drop 2020",         run_b(filter(ib, year != 2020), "+ covid_cases_p100k"))
)
print(res, digits = 3)
readr::write_csv(res, file.path(output_dir, "covid_robustness_sectionB.csv"))
```
